name: @neuropause/deployment-orchestrator
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Launch Workstream 5: Pilot Deployment, General Availability & Business Launch. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, and Launch Workstreams 1-4, unchanged, into a governed deployment-orchestration & launch layer: an enterprise deployment orchestrator (deployment registry/lifecycle, rollout & rollback plans, environment registry, deployment templates, validation); a pilot customer program (pilot registry, readiness, success criteria, hypercare, feedback, completion — pilot organizations represented until contracted); reusable government & public-sector deployment profile TEMPLATES (national ministries, state departments, municipal corporations, healthcare authorities, education departments, public utilities, law enforcement, smart cities — templates only, never a claimed deployment); an enterprise rollout framework (single/multi-tenant, regional/global, rollout waves, controlled releases); a General Availability program (GA checklist, release approval, executive approval, go/no-go, version promotion, rollback governance — reusing the Sprint-6 Release GA gate whose result is hard-flagged releasedToRealWorld:false); customer success operations (health, adoption, playbooks, EBRs, renewals, expansion — measured data only); commercial operations (opportunity/proposal/quote/contract/license-activation/renewal registries — contracts and revenue never fabricated); a partner ecosystem (SI/consulting/technology/marketplace/training partner registries, represented until agreements exist); government readiness (department/agency profiles, security-classification & governance templates, approval workflows, operational dashboards — operational models only); a Launch Operations Center (deployment-pipeline/platform/customer/government/commercial/support/executive dashboards, verified data only); training & enablement registries; documentation; a business launch-readiness validator that composes the reused readiness of the platform, connectivity, trust, customer-experience, and release layers into a launch-readiness score; and governance. The deployment runtime, rollout engine, deployment templates, GA program, launch operations center, customer-success runtime, commercial registry, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; CRM/ERP/identity/email/payment providers and marketplace APIs are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; pilot/enterprise/government customers, contracts, revenue, renewals, and production adoption are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and customer production environments, government production networks, national cloud infrastructure, production rollouts, and marketplace publication are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No enterprise, government, or public-sector deployment; procurement approval; signed contract; production revenue; or marketplace publication is ever claimed. This is deployment READINESS, not claimed deployment. Every deployment is recorded on the one governance chain with a replay id.
